law_name: Law No. 03/2016 of 10 May 2016 on the Protection of Personal Data
scope: Data subjects in Sao Tome and Principe (unconfirmed)
applies_to: Public and private controllers and processors (unconfirmed)
key_requirements: Notification/registration of processing and cross-border transfers with the ANPDP; processing principles and processor agreements; data subject rights; no breach notification, DPO or DPIA duty
penalties_range: Administrative fines of USD 1,250 to 50,000 plus civil and criminal penalties (Miranda); another source gives STN 50M-120M individuals and STN 250M-500M entities (conflicting) (unconfirmed)
notes: ANPDP organisation set by Law 7/2017 of 6 April 2017 (VdA); fine figures conflict across sources
